meta.name: Yuzu 表情プロンプト
meta.description: Yuzu（オリジナルキャラクター）用の表情差分プロンプト集。Whisk の画像生成（参照画像アップロード→image-to-image モデル化）での利用を想定。
meta.author: GitHub Copilot
meta.usage_notes: まずは各エントリの `combined_prompt` を試し、必要に応じて `positives` を組み合わせてください。ネガティブトークンは必ず含めてください。
meta.image_model_usage: Upload the reference image at `doc/02_Characters/images/Yuzu/yuzu.png` to Whisk, create/use an image model for Yuzu, and use image-to-image generation where possible.

color_preservation.instruction: Preserve reference image color balance; do not apply per-expression color tints (e.g., no blue or warm overlay). Maintain natural skin tone and global color grading consistent with the reference image.

pose_preservation.instruction: Preserve reference head pose and camera angle — do NOT change face orientation, rotation, or head tilt. Use `doc/02_Characters/images/Yuzu/yuzu.png` as the pose reference.

ribbon_preservation.instruction: Ensure Yuzu's ribbon is placed on the viewer-left side of the image (character's right). Do NOT place ribbon on the viewer-right side; if multiple ribbons appear, primary ribbon must remain viewer-left.

cutout_defaults.note_jp: 切り抜き用の白い枠（透過ではなく白背景）を必ず付与してください。
